method.summary: Does the text this server returns carry the version the agent asked for, when that version is OLDER than the one the corpus defaults to? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness) in the older direction of #329, applied to microsoft_docs_search with a NEW tuple set, because none of #322's subjects is in this corpus: eight (subject, concept) tuples, each with one token exclusive to the older version and one to the newer, both verified on the vendor's own live pages before the pre-registration; question names the subject, the version and the concept, never an identifier; case-sensitive substring over the concatenated text of the tool result (ten chunks per call); five outcomes fixed in advance; n=8, one run, one container, 2026-10-30 12:15:04Z to 12:15:24Z. RESULT: 2 version-correct (Entity Framework 6 relationships, ASP.NET 4.8 web-root path), 3 version-wrong (Cosmos DB .NET SDK v2 client, query, upsert: only v3 identifiers, 0 of 10 chunks from a v2 page in each, while the v2 reference pages are live), 3 version-mixed (Cosmos v2 page size, ASP.NET 4.8 HTTP context, ASP.NET MVC 5 routing), 0 silent, 0 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200. DESIGN-STEP FINDING, the sixth row: of 28 candidate version pairs checked on learn.microsoft.com, 14 were dropped because Learn no longer publishes the older version's page (legacy Azure SDK references redirect to an archive overview; ASP.NET Core 2.2 and PowerShell 7.4 views fall back), so no search over this corpus can pin to those versions. LIMITS: four of eight tuples are on one subject (Cosmos DB .NET SDK v2 vs v3), three on ASP.NET Framework vs Core; a single chunk naming the newer identifier makes a trial mixed. Exploratory, barred from results: the same eight asked for the NEWER version gave 3 correct, 5 mixed, 0 wrong. The baselined row is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong', baseline 1 = some; 3 of 8 is some.
method.dataset: Eight (subject, concept) tuples asked for the OLDER version: Entity Framework 6 (vs Core 8); Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK v2 (vs v3), four concepts: client, page size, query, upsert; ASP.NET 4.8 on .NET Framework (vs Core 8.0), HTTP context and web-root path; ASP.NET MVC 5 (vs Core 8.0), routing.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error, isError true or empty text)
candidate version pairs dropped: older version's page no longer published

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's microsoft-learn-mcp entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
